covers: The Wall Street close on Monday 23 Nov 2026, HPE results after the close, Asia and commodities on Tuesday morning, and the week ahead for South Africa
headline: Wall Street has its best day since April 2025 as Nvidia jumps 31.5% on Huang's return; Dell reports tonight
summary: The S&P 500 closed Monday 23 Nov 2026 up 4.7%, the Nasdaq 100 up 6.9% and the Dow up 3%, the strongest session since April 2025, with Nvidia up 31.5% after Jensen Huang was reinstated as CEO; Asia followed on Tuesday with the Kospi up 6.2% and the Nikkei up 3.7% (Saxo, 24 Nov 2026). Brent closed Monday at $89.37 and WTI at $80.17, and was a little lower again on Tuesday, while spot gold was near $3,635 early Tuesday (Saxo; Kotak Neo, 24 Nov 2026). For South Africa the main events this week are US PCE inflation on Wednesday and the Moody's and S&P reviews late on Friday 27 Nov; we could not verify Tuesday's JSE and rand levels from an opened article at publication time, so they are left out.

items.title: Monday close: S&P 500 +4.7%, Nasdaq 100 +6.9%, Dow +3%, best session since April 2025
items.summary: US stocks had their strongest day since April 2025 on Monday 23 Nov 2026 after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. Nvidia rose 31.5%, Tesla 11.5% and Meta 6.6%; CrowdStrike fell 8.9% after agreeing a $43.9 billion all-share deal for Zscaler. The VIX volatility gauge fell about a quarter to 26.62. Europe also rose: Stoxx 600 +1.8%, FTSE 100 +1.3% (Saxo Market Quick Take, 24 Nov 2026). The rally followed seven straight daily falls for the S&P 500 (Charles Schwab, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: HPE beats forecasts and raises its outlook, but shares fall 6.7% after hours
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise reported fourth-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.43 a share on revenue of $14.5 billion, ahead of estimates of $1.27 and $14.35 billion; revenue rose 50% from a year earlier. It guided fiscal 2027 revenue to $59-63 billion and adjusted EPS to $5.05-5.35. The shares closed the regular session up 17.4% at $48.02, then fell 6.7% after hours to $44.81 (Investing.com, 24 Nov 2026). HPE is not on our coverage list.

items.title: Treasury yields ease; US consumer confidence today, Dell and others report after the close
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield peaked near 4.98% on Monday and was about 4.91% early Tuesday; the 2-year eased from 4.73% to 4.67%. The US flash composite PMI fell to 54.6 in November from 55.9. Today: US November consumer confidence at 15:00 GMT (17:00 SAST) and results from Dell, Analog Devices, Medtronic, Workday, HP and Autodesk. The Fed decides on 9 Dec (Saxo, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa due late on Friday 27 Nov, both on positive outlooks
items.summary: Both agencies are scheduled to publish their South Africa reviews late on Friday; each currently has a positive outlook on the country (BusinessTech Africa, 23 Nov 2026). An upgrade or an outlook change would be a market-moving event for the rand and SA bonds. Before that, US PCE inflation and the second estimate of third-quarter GDP on Wednesday 25 Nov are the main outside drivers for the rand (Charles Schwab, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Coca-Cola HBC's purchase of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa due to close on Friday
items.summary: After its JSE debut on Monday 23 Nov 2026 at a value of about R341 billion, Coca-Cola HBC expects its purchase of a 75% stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa to close on 27 Nov (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Brent near $89 and WTI near $80 after Monday's 3.5-4% fall
items.summary: Brent fell 3.5% to $89.37 and WTI 4% to $80.17 on Monday 23 Nov 2026, and on Tuesday morning Brent was down about 0.4% near $89 and WTI about 0.2% near $80. US-Iran talks remain unresolved, and the Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's Rabigh refinery, which Saudi officials have not confirmed. Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent forecast to $105 from $90 (Kotak Neo, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: Gold near $3,635, silver $42.70, copper up about 2.6% on the LME
items.summary: Spot gold was around $3,635 early Tuesday 24 Nov 2026 and silver at $42.70 (-0.8%). LME copper rose 2.6% on Monday. EUR/USD was back above 1.0910 and GBP/USD above 1.3040 early Tuesday; USD/JPY was near 159.15 (Saxo, 24 Nov 2026). A USD/ZAR level and platinum price could not be verified from an opened article this morning.

items.title: Nvidia closes up 31.5% after Huang's return (rating BUY, unchanged)
items.summary: Nvidia gained 31.5% on Monday 23 Nov 2026 after the board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO (Saxo, 24 Nov 2026). The board's independent investigation continues, so news flow is likely to stay heavy. Based on Monday's intraday price near $165.61, the shares remain below our fair value estimate of $262.56.

items.title: Dell reports after the US close tonight (rating SELL, unchanged); Meta +6.6% (SELL, unchanged)
items.summary: Dell reports on Tuesday 24 Nov after the US close (about 23:00 SAST onward) (Saxo, 24 Nov 2026); it rose about 22% intraday on Monday to near $340 (Investing.com, 23 Nov 2026), still below our $404.70 fair value estimate. A results-day move of more than 5% would be flagged in the evening update. Meta rose 6.6% on Monday (Saxo) and remains below our $677.14 estimate. No company-specific news was found for Intuit, Deckers, Paylocity, AMD, Arista, Fastenal or Wabtec.
